title: 風濕免疫科
intro: 自體免疫與發炎性關節疾病的診斷與生物製劑治療。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Diagnosis and biologic therapy of autoimmune and inflammatory joint disease. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 晨僵與小關節腫：看模式
procedures.titleEn: Morning stiffness and swollen small joints: recognise the pattern
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：39 歲女性雙手小關節腫、晨僵且持續數週。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 39-year-old woman has persistent small-joint swelling and morning stiffness. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 虛擬病史：晨僵約 90 分鐘、雙手多個小關節腫持續 8 週；類風濕因子陰性。
stages.evidenceEn: Simulated history: about 90 minutes of morning stiffness and multiple swollen hand joints for eight weeks, with negative rheumatoid factor.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 依臨床滑膜炎轉介評估
choices.en: Refer based on clinical synovitis

choices.zh: 抗體陰性就排除所有發炎關節炎
choices.en: Negative antibodies exclude all inflammatory arthritis

choices.zh: 只等 X 光出現侵蝕才轉介
choices.en: Wait for radiographic erosions before referral

stages.reason: 陰性抗體不能單獨排除疾病。
stages.reasonEn: Negative antibodies alone cannot exclude disease.
stages.pitfall: 等破壞出現才評估可能延誤。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for damage may delay care.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 她疼痛改善，但關節腫脹與功能限制仍在。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain improves but swelling and functional limitation persist.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只追發炎指數不問日常能力
choices.en: Follow markers without asking about function

choices.zh: 整合活動度與功能追蹤
choices.en: Follow disease activity and function

choices.zh: 疼痛變少就代表疾病完全控制
choices.en: Less pain means fully controlled disease

stages.reason: 症狀、滑膜炎與功能需一起看。
stages.reasonEn: Symptoms, synovitis and function need combined review.
stages.pitfall: 只止痛可能掩蓋持續發炎。
stages.pitfallEn: Pain relief alone can hide ongoing inflammation.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 關節分布、持續時間、滑膜炎、功能與疾病活動追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: Distribution, duration, synovitis, function and disease-activity review.
stages.question: 抗體陰性但小關節持續腫脹；轉介摘要應如何表達？
stages.questionEn: Antibodies are negative but small-joint swelling persists. How should referral describe this?

choices.zh: 抗體陰性即排除
choices.en: Negative antibodies exclude it

choices.zh: 只交班疼痛改善
choices.en: Hand over improved pain alone

choices.zh: 持續滑膜炎與功能受限
choices.en: Persistent synovitis and functional limitation

stages.reason: 陰性抗體不能抵銷臨床滑膜炎，腫脹與功能是重要資料。
stages.reasonEn: Negative antibodies do not negate clinical synovitis; swelling and function remain important.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：晨僵與小關節腫：看模式。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Morning stiffness and swollen small joints: recognise the pattern.

procedures.title: 紅腫熱痛單關節：不能先認定痛風
procedures.titleEn: A hot single joint: do not assume gout
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：70 歲男性膝關節突然腫痛，同時發燒。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 70-year-old man has sudden knee swelling and fever. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 他有痛風病史，但這次不能負重且全身不適。
stages.evidenceEn: He has gout history but cannot bear weight and feels systemically ill.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只按血尿酸高低決定全部診斷
choices.en: Decide the entire diagnosis from serum urate

choices.zh: 緊急評估感染性關節炎
choices.en: Urgently assess septic arthritis

choices.zh: 有痛風史就排除關節感染
choices.en: Gout history excludes joint infection

stages.reason: 痛風與感染可能相似，甚至共存。
stages.reasonEn: Gout and infection can resemble one another or coexist.
stages.pitfall: 漏掉感染會延誤重要照護。

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 專業團隊取得關節液，晶體與培養資訊待整合。
stages.evidenceEn: A qualified team obtains fluid; crystals and cultures need integration.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 發現晶體就永遠不需追培養
choices.en: Crystals mean cultures never need follow-up

choices.zh: 只看關節液顏色就可結案
choices.en: Close the case from fluid colour alone

choices.zh: 整合晶體、微生物與病況
choices.en: Integrate crystals, microbiology and clinical state

stages.reason: 單一檢驗不能回答所有問題。
stages.reasonEn: One test cannot answer every question.
stages.pitfall: 漏追培養可能漏掉共同感染。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreviewed cultures can miss coexisting infection.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 發燒與負重能力、關節液及培養、感染風險與追蹤負責人。
stages.evidenceEn: Fever and weight-bearing, joint fluid and cultures, infection risk and follow-up owner.
stages.question: 發燒腫膝有痛風史，晶體與培養待回；接班需保留哪個判斷？
stages.questionEn: A febrile swollen knee has gout history and pending crystal-culture results. What must be retained?

choices.zh: 感染仍未排除
choices.en: Infection remains unexcluded

choices.zh: 有晶體即排除感染，下次發作才看培養
choices.en: End infection assessment if crystals appear and review cultures only at the next attack

choices.zh: 只記痛風病史
choices.en: Record gout history alone

stages.reason: 晶體性關節炎與感染可能共存，不能用既有病史或單項檢驗結案。
stages.reasonEn: Crystal arthritis and infection may coexist; history or one test cannot close the assessment.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：紅腫熱痛單關節：不能先認定痛風。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of A hot single joint: do not assume gout.

procedures.title: 痛風不痛以後：長期管理仍重要
procedures.titleEn: After gout pain settles: long-term review
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲男性一年反覆關節急性發作，近期不再疼痛。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 52-year-old man has recurrent attacks over a year but is currently pain-free. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 他想只在疼痛發作時處理，其他時間完全不追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: He wants care only during painful attacks.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 沒有疼痛就代表尿酸問題已消失
choices.en: No pain means urate problems have vanished

choices.zh: 所有人只靠禁掉單一食物即可
choices.en: Everyone needs only avoidance of one food

choices.zh: 討論復發風險與長期計畫
choices.en: Discuss recurrence and a long-term plan

stages.reason: 急性疼痛與長期尿酸負擔不同。
stages.reasonEn: Acute pain differs from long-term urate burden.
stages.pitfall: 只追發作會忽略累積影響。

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 有腎病與多種藥物；過去曾自行停藥。
stages.evidenceEn: He has kidney disease, several medicines and prior self-discontinuation.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 個別核對用藥與追蹤
choices.en: Individualise medicine review and monitoring

choices.zh: 對所有人套用同一藥物劑量
choices.en: Use an identical dose for everyone

choices.zh: 只要吃藥就永遠不用檢驗
choices.en: Treatment means tests are never needed

stages.reason: 共病與用藥影響安全計畫。
stages.reasonEn: Comorbidity and medicines shape safe care.
stages.pitfall: 沒有共同決策容易再自行停藥。
stages.pitfallEn: No shared plan may lead to another interruption.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 發作頻率、共病、尿酸追蹤、用藥耐受與共同照護目標。
stages.evidenceEn: Attack frequency, comorbidity, urate monitoring, tolerance and shared goals.
stages.question: 疼痛已退但反覆發作且有腎病；離院追蹤需要哪項？
stages.questionEn: Pain resolves after recurrent attacks in a patient with kidney disease. What follow-up is needed?

choices.zh: 痛退即結案，下次發作才查停藥史
choices.en: End follow-up after pain resolves and review prior self-discontinuation only at the next attack

choices.zh: 共病用藥與長期追蹤
choices.en: Comorbidities, medicines and long-term follow-up

choices.zh: 只交班止痛效果
choices.en: Hand over pain relief alone

stages.reason: 發作緩解不等於長期風險消失，用藥安全需配合腎病個別評估。
stages.reasonEn: Attack relief does not remove long-term risk; medicine safety needs individual renal review.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：痛風不痛以後：長期管理仍重要。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of After gout pain settles: long-term review.

procedures.title: 狼瘡與泡泡尿：別只追皮疹
procedures.titleEn: Lupus and foamy urine: look beyond the rash
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲女性狼瘡追蹤中皮疹改善，但出現水腫與泡泡尿。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 29-year-old woman with lupus has improving rash but new oedema and foamy urine. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 尿檢顯示蛋白與血尿，肌酸酐還不高。
stages.evidenceEn: Urine shows protein and blood while creatinine is not high.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 評估腎臟受累可能
choices.en: Assess possible renal involvement

choices.zh: 肌酸酐不高就排除狼瘡腎炎
choices.en: A non-elevated creatinine excludes lupus nephritis

choices.zh: 皮疹變好就代表所有器官改善
choices.en: Improved rash means every organ improves

stages.reason: 不同器官活動可能不一致。
stages.reasonEn: Disease activity can differ between organs.
stages.pitfall: 只追皮膚會漏掉腎臟問題。
stages.pitfallEn: Skin-only review can miss renal disease.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 她正在用免疫治療，同時有新發燒。
stages.evidenceEn: She uses immune therapy and develops a fever.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 先停掉所有藥物不通知團隊
choices.en: Stop every medicine without telling the team

choices.zh: 評估感染與疾病活動
choices.en: Assess infection and disease activity

choices.zh: 所有發燒都自動增加免疫抑制
choices.en: Automatically increase immune suppression for every fever

stages.reason: 感染與活動需區分且可共存。
stages.reasonEn: Infection and activity must be distinguished and may coexist.
stages.pitfall: 錯誤歸因會影響治療安全。

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 尿蛋白與沉渣、腎功能、狼瘡活動、感染線索與共同追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: Proteinuria, sediment, renal function, lupus activity, infection clues and coordinated follow-up.
stages.question: 皮疹改善但蛋白血尿與發燒新出現；交班應突出什麼？
stages.questionEn: Rash improves but proteinuria, haematuria and fever emerge. What should be highlighted?

choices.zh: 皮疹改善即穩定
choices.en: Improved rash means stability

choices.zh: 只記皮疹改善
choices.en: Record rash improvement alone

choices.zh: 腎臟受累與感染待查
choices.en: Possible renal involvement and infection assessment

stages.reason: 不同器官病程可不同，且免疫治療期間仍需辨識感染。
stages.reasonEn: Organs can follow different courses, and infection remains relevant during immune therapy.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：狼瘡與泡泡尿：別只追皮疹。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Lupus and foamy urine: look beyond the rash.

procedures.title: 新頭痛與視覺改變：辨識時間敏感警訊
procedures.titleEn: New headache and visual change: recognise urgency
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲女性新發頭痛、咀嚼時下顎疼痛，今天短暫視覺模糊。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 74-year-old woman has new headache, jaw pain when chewing and transient visual blurring. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 年輕人的背痛：找發炎模式
procedures.titleEn: Back pain in a young adult: seek an inflammatory pattern
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：30 歲男性背痛數月，休息較僵硬，活動後較舒服。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 30-year-old man has months of back pain, worse stiffness with rest and relief with activity. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 生物製劑前：效益與感染風險核對
procedures.titleEn: Before a biologic: balance benefit and infection risk
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：47 歲女性發炎性關節病準備升級治療，過去曾罹患結核。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 47-year-old woman with inflammatory arthritis is considered for treatment escalation and has prior tuberculosis. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: ANA 陽性：檢驗不是病名
procedures.titleEn: Positive ANA: a test is not a diagnosis
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：41 歲女性因疲倦接受篩檢，ANA 陽性，沒有明確器官症狀。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 41-year-old woman investigated for fatigue has positive ANA without clear organ symptoms. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 口乾眼乾：從症狀走向系統性評估
procedures.titleEn: Dry eyes and mouth: from symptoms to systemic assessment
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：53 歲患者長期口乾眼乾、齲齒增加，另有疲倦與關節不適。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 53-year-old has persistent dry eyes and mouth, more dental caries, fatigue and joint symptoms.

procedures.title: 無力與疼痛需要分清楚
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：39 歲患者爬樓梯、起身與梳頭越來越困難，另有皮疹。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 39-year-old increasingly struggles with stairs, rising and combing hair, with a skin eruption.

procedures.title: 硬皮症患者血壓突然改變
procedures.titleEn: A sudden blood-pressure change in systemic sclerosis
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：已知全身性硬化症患者今天頭痛、視覺不適，血壓較平常明顯升高。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A patient with systemic sclerosis develops headache, visual discomfort and blood pressure markedly above baseline.

procedures.title: 紫斑、足下垂與腎臟變化
procedures.titleEn: Purpura, foot drop and renal changes
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：61 歲患者腿部紫斑、單側足下垂與尿液異常，起初以為只是鞋子壓傷。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 61-year-old develops leg purpura, unilateral foot drop and urinary abnormalities, initially blamed on footwear.

procedures.title: 類風濕性關節炎治療（T2T）
procedures.patient: 依課程「類風濕性關節炎治療（T2T）」設定的虛擬情境：ACR/EULAR 分類、methotrexate、生物製劑與 JAK 抑制劑。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Rheumatoid arthritis treat-to-target": Classification, methotrexate, biologics and JAK inhibitors. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.en: Key element 3: biologics and JAK inhibitors

procedures.title: 全身性紅斑狼瘡
procedures.patient: 依課程「全身性紅斑狼瘡」設定的虛擬情境：ANA／dsDNA、hydroxychloroquine 與器官受累治療。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Systemic lupus erythematosus": ANA/dsDNA, hydroxychloroquine and organ-specific therapy. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

procedures.title: 僵直性脊椎炎與脊椎關節炎
procedures.patient: 依課程「僵直性脊椎炎與脊椎關節炎」設定的虛擬情境：HLA-B27、MRI 薦髂關節與抗 TNF／IL-17。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Axial spondyloarthritis": HLA-B27, sacroiliac MRI and anti-TNF/IL-17. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

procedures.title: 乾癬性關節炎
procedures.patient: 依課程「乾癬性關節炎」設定的虛擬情境：CASPAR、附著點炎與標靶治療。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Psoriatic arthritis": CASPAR criteria, enthesitis and targeted therapy. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 2：附著點炎與標…

procedures.title: 痛風長期管理
procedures.patient: 依課程「痛風長期管理」設定的虛擬情境：allopurinol 劑量滴定、HLA-B*58:01 篩檢與 febuxostat。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。

procedures.patient: 依課程「兒童關節炎與成人轉銜」設定的虛擬情境：辨認生長眼部與關節影響；評估自我管理準備；交班免疫與疫苗紀錄 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Juvenile arthritis and transition to adult care": Recognize growth ocular and joint effects; Assess readiness for self-management; Handover immune and vaccination records The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
